port.description: Port number on which sshd listens for incoming connections.

listen_address.description: IP address to bind the SSH daemon to. Use * or 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use for logging (e.g., AUTH, AUTHPRIV, DAEMON).

log_level.description: Verbosity level for sshd logs (NONE, QUIET, FATAL, ERROR, INFO, VERBOSE, DEBUG, etc.).

login_grace_time.description: Time (in seconds) the server waits for authentication before disconnecting.

permit_root_login.description: Whether root may log in. Options: 'yes', 'no', 'without-password', 'prohibit-password'.

strict_modes.description: Check file permissions of user's key files and home directory before allowing login.

max_auth_tries.description: Maximum number of authentication attempts permitted per connection.

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of open sessions per connection. Set to 0 for unlimited.

pubkey_authentication.description: Enable or disable public key (SSH key) authentication.

authorized_keys_file.description: List of file paths (relative to user's home) containing authorized public keys.

authentication_methods.description: Ordered list of authentication methods (e.g., ['publickey,password']). Leave empty to use default.

use_pam.description: Enable PAM for authentication, account, session, and password management.

allow_users.description: List of usernames allowed to log in (empty = all allowed unless denied).

allow_groups.description: List of Unix group names allowed to log in (empty = all allowed unless denied).

deny_users.description: List of usernames explicitly denied login access.

deny_groups.description: List of Unix group names explicitly denied login access.

accept_env.description: List of environment variable patterns accepted from the client (supports wildcards like LC_*).

banner_path.description: Path to the banner file displayed before authentication. Set to empty string '' to disable.

x11_forwarding.description: Enable X11 forwarding for GUI applications over SSH.

x11_display_offset.description: First X11 display number reserved for SSH (10 + session number).

x11_use_localhost.description: Bind X11 forwarding to localhost only (security best practice).

gateway_ports.description: Allow remote hosts to connect to ports forwarded for the client.

client_alive_interval.description: Seconds between keepalive messages. 0 disables them.

client_alive_count.description: Maximum number of client alive messages sent without response before disconnecting.

max_sessions_per_connection.description: Alias for MaxSessions; maximum number of open sessions per connection.

subsystem_sftp.description: Path to the sftp-server subsystem executable (or 'internal-sftp').

host_key_algorithms.description: List of host key algorithms the server offers (empty = default).

host_key.description: List of host private key files (one per key type).

kex_algorithms.description: List of key exchange algorithms (empty = default).

revoked_keys.description: Path to a file listing revoked public keys.

authorized_principals_file.description: Path to file containing authorized principals for certificate-based auth.

authorized_principals_command.description: Path to a command returning authorized principals.

authorized_principals_command_user.description: User to run the authorized_principals_command as.

fingerprints_hash.description: Hash algorithm used to display key fingerprints (SHA256, SHA1, none).

login_rsa_auth.description: Deprecated. Enable RSA authentication for login. Use PubkeyAuthentication instead.

rsa_authentication.description: Deprecated. Enable RSA authentication. Use PubkeyAuthentication instead.

kerberos_or_local_passwd.description: If Kerberos auth fails, try system passwd.

kerberos_ticket_cleanup.description: Destroy Kerberos ticket cache on logout.

kerberos_get_afs_token.description: Get AFS token if user is in AFS.

use_dns.description: Perform reverse DNS lookup on connecting client.

hostbased_uses_name_from_packet_only.description: Accept hostname from client packet, not just from /etc/hosts.

force_command.description: Force execution of a command regardless of what the client requests.

print_motd.description: Print /etc/motd at login (if PAM motd isn't used).

tcp_keep_alive.description: Send TCP keepalive messages (use ClientAliveInterval instead).

compression_level.description: Compression level (1-9) when compression is enabled.

rekey_limit.description: Limit on data volume or time before rekeying (e.g., '1G 1h').

security_key_provider.description: Path to FIDO security key provider library.

allow_streamlocal_forwarding.description: Allow local/remote port forwarding and Unix socket forwarding.

disable_forwarding.description: Disable all forwarding (implies no port, tunnel, agent, streamlocal).

ip_qos_policy.description: IP QoS for traffic classification (control, cs0, cs1, cs2, cs3, cs4, cs5, cs6, cs7, ef, af11, af12, af13, af21, af22, af23, af31, af32, af33, af41, af42, af43, voicex, voice-ads, network-control).

ip_tos.description: Deprecated alias for IPQosPolicy (hex or keyword).

ip_port.description: Deprecated alias for Port (set Port instead).

bind_address.description: Deprecated alias for ListenAddress (use ListenAddress instead).

log_facility.description: Syslog facility to use for logging (e.g., AUTH, AUTHPRIV, DAEMON).
